chapters: The Emergence of the Core Concepts
From Documentation System to Knowledge Architecture
coverage.method: Complete source read; overlapping chunks cover every paragraph, header, list and all five views

findings.before: Family/Type and Revision absent; Approved/Baseline 1.0 received.
findings.proposal: Add Family Foundation, Type Reference: primary responsibility is historical evolution, with non-binding future directions rather than an executable evolution process. Preserve Arnaldo attribution and received history; attribute actual update separately, Draft/unassigned first Revision 1.
findings.closure_criterion: Header follows historical responsibility with no invented Component/Class, approval or Revision 0.

findings.before: Historical Architecture/Research/Specification/META/Template/Analysis labels are not explicitly separated from current Family/Type rules.
findings.proposal: Retain historical vocabulary as historical subject/role groupings; distinguish current component/documentary-area Family and four responsibility-based Types. Apply functional-file exclusions, retain stable ID independent of classification/location/edition.
findings.closure_criterion: Historical terms are preserved without authorizing extra current Types, family-by-title inference or functional-file normalization.
findings.related_records: REV2-03; REV2-04; INV-02 remains Not applicable

findings.before: Knowledge/Documentation/Storage hierarchy and five concern layers can be read as current structural allocation.
findings.proposal: Label these as historical conceptual views. Distinguish five concerns from seven structural areas; Knowledge subject matter, Preservation cross-cutting, Metadata primary Documentation and Baselines Governance. Reference Architecture ownership and pending six/seven discrepancy.
findings.closure_criterion: No additional Knowledge/Storage/Preservation structural layer inferred; historical and current views explicitly separated.

findings.before: Metadata is official structural information for all components; Registry cannot contain knowledge; reference evolution into dependencies does not preserve relation kinds/owner.
findings.proposal: Separate descriptor representation from Identity/Classification/Governance domain authority. Relationships owns typed records; Registry/Graph provide traceable indexes/projections, including permitted derived values with edition provenance. References remain references unless a required contract justifies dependency.
findings.closure_criterion: No universal Metadata semantic authority or physical no-copy rule; relationship ownership and derived projections explicit.

findings.before: Baseline described as consistent knowledge state without exact selected editions or validation/approval/inclusion distinctions.
findings.proposal: Preserve historical transition from versioning to snapshot concept; link current exact immutable edition selection with pinned relevant context/evidence, explicit approval and inclusion. Distinguish contributions, review, validation and approval; changed working editions do not alter historical Baseline members.
findings.closure_criterion: Baseline synopsis identifies exact selection and separate gates; historical declarations are not renewed; future disk changes require evidence on resulting bytes.

findings.before: Five ASCII views lack explicit relation meaning; architectural sequences resemble dependencies.
findings.proposal: Retain fe2-1/fe2-2/fe3-1/fe4-1/fe5-1, replace with typed tables: taxonomy example, conceptual emergence, abstraction view, component association and historical stages. Required dependencies if asserted must use consumer-to-provider with contract/scope; do not conceal genuine cycles.
findings.closure_criterion: Five view meanings/direction explicit; historical sequence not a proven execution chain, current layer hierarchy or global mandatory DAG.

findings.before: Foundations/roles unchanged and extension/scaling requires no structural changes, expressed as unconditional guarantees.
findings.proposal: Preserve stability as historical design intent; extensions require impact/compatibility assessment and may require coordinated contract evolution. Future possibilities remain non-binding, no executable process or new component/catalog invented.
findings.closure_criterion: No guarantee that extension, technology integration or scaling never changes contracts/structure; current governance authority distinct from historical intentions.

findings.before: Implementation, hundreds/thousands scale, reuse and present maturity claimed without supplied assessment evidence/date.
findings.proposal: Retain received historical assessments, qualify implementation/scale/reuse/benefit as unverified here or intended capability. No invented event dates, benchmarks, release readiness or approval.
findings.closure_criterion: Current-state language has explicit evidence limits; no operational maturity/scalability guarantee inferred from architecture or local review.

findings.before: No operational links or dated evidence anchors distinguish retrospective stages from current specifications and chronology records.
findings.proposal: Add concise actual-path reference map for Blueprint/Manifest/Rationale/Research Journal/Evolution Timeline and policy/report; distinguish chronology, rationale and current owner contracts. Do not invent dates or promote narrative order into verified dated events.
findings.closure_criterion: Links resolve to expected identities; chronology is qualitative unless evidence supports dates; related sources not silently updated.

result: REVIEW complete with seven findings and two warnings; source unchanged; UPDATE/VALIDATE not performed
